rdzis bskyod mkha' la mngon par lhags// rgyal ba'i sras po mthu chen ldan rnams lhags gyur pa'i// rmad byung mchog la mchod pa de ltar byed par gyur// lha klu dri za'i tshogs rnams kun gyis 'dud par gyur// de tshe gsang ba'i bdag po ni// rdo rje 'bar thogs phyi bzhin 'brang*// sa ni rir bcas shin tu g.yos// 'od zer drwa bas phyogs rnams kun// gsal zhing dri med lhang nger gyur// de tshe ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal kun// zhi zhing bde bar gnas par gyur// rmad du byung ba'i bkod pa dag

/ngag du brjod par nus ma yin// de ltar khab nas byung bar gyur// byang chub sems dpa' dpag tshad drug du phyin pa dang nam langs te lha'i tshogs rnams kyang slar bkye nas/ sngags ldan dang rgyan thams cad mos pa la gtad de gsungs pa/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan pa ni// lam gyi mchog de ma thob par// grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir ni slar// nga ni 'jug par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs nas dal bus gshegs so// 'dun pa yang yid mi dga' bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ rta dang rgyan khyer te song ngo*// de nas byang chub sems dpas rang gi dbu skra ut+pa la sngon po'i mdog can gyi ras gris rang gi lag pas bregs te dor ba dang*/ mig stong dang ldan pas khyer te deng sang yang sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams gtsug phud kyi dus ston byed do// de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du rab tu byung ba la gos ka shi ka mdzes pa ma yin no snyam pa dang*/ lha'i bu zhig gis sha na'i gos ngur smrig bgos te rngon pa'i cha lugs su byang chub sems dpa'i drung du phyin pa dang de la bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyi ngur smrig dag nga la byin la/ gos ka shi ka 'di dag khyer cig gsungs nas/ ngur smrig blangs te gsol to// de nas gus pa dang bcas pas gos ka shi ka dag blangs te khyer ro// 'dun pa yang phyir ser skya'i gzhir zhugs pa dang ca co dang ngu cho'i sgra chen po mngon par grags so// de nas yab rgyal pos 'dun pa la smras pa/ gzhon nu gang du bzhud/ bzlog pa lta nus sam/ des smras pa/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du grong khyer mi 'jug go zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin du smras te/ byang chub sems dpa'i mthus skye bo rnamasakyi mya ngan gyi mthu bsal zhing spro bar byas so// dman pa rnams ni longs spyod cung zad phyir// dpal las nyams shing sna tshogs sdug bsngal 'gyur// de dang de la 'dod pas kun tu zhugs// dam pa rnams ni brgya byin dpal gyi mthu// zil gnon dpal yang ral gri'i so ltar dgongs// de yang legs pa'i dpal gyis rnam par brgyan// rgya mtsho'i sa yang rlabs kyis bskyod pa bzhin// g.yo bar byed na sems dang ldan pa dag

de las gzhan du byed pa mthu med dam// e ma'o byang chub mchog gi spyod pa brtan// 'gro ba'i nyi ma cig pu bla na med/// /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rim gyis ljongs rgyu zhing shākya dang ghe'u ta dang gyad kyi yul las kyang 'das te byon pa na thog mar bram ze rigs ldan gyis byang chub sems dpa' zas la mgron du bos so// de bzhin du rim gyis bram ze pad ma dang bram ze drang srong nam gru dang bram ze 'od ldan dang sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur dang*/ rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod rnams kyis kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa' la bkur sti dam pa byas shing de dag gi ting nge 'dzin dang yon tan gyi khyad par las rmad du byung ba bstan te/ rim gyis ljongs rgyu zhing rgyal po'i khab kyi ri'i rgyal po skya bor byon te bzhugs pa na grong khyer pa thams cad ya mtshan du gyur te/ lus kyi yon tan rmad du byung ba skye bo rnams kyis mthong nas yon tan bsgrags pas/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa'i drung du song te/ nam mkha' dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa gza' skar gyi dpal gyi lham mer gyur ba bzhin du/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'bar ba mthong nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ dge slong mchog ni gang dang gang nas 'ongs// gang du khyod skyes yab yum gang na bzhugs/ dpal ldan khyod mthong bdag yid dgar gyur pas// rgyal srid 'bul gyis bde bar spyad par mdzod// ces bya ba la sogs pa du ma smras pa slar gsungs pa/ rgyal po shākya rnams kyi ser skya'i grong*// mchog tu 'byor zhing rgyas pa thos gyur tam// kho bo'i pha yi ming ni zas gtsang ngo*// de spangs yon tan 'dod pas rab tu byung*// 'dod pa dug 'dra nyes pa mtha' yas ldan// sems dmyal yid dwags dud 'gror ltung byed pa// smad pa de ni ngar snabs bzhin du dor// kho bo 'dod pa'i yon tan mi 'dod do// zhes bya ba la sogs pa chos dang ldan pa'i gtam yang dag par bstan nas/

rgyal pos kyang bzod par gsol te/ gang gi tshe byang chub brnyes pa na bdag la'ang brtse bas bzung du gsol/ zhes brjod nas slar yang song ngo*// de nas byang chub sems dpa' steng rgyas kyi grong khyer du byon pa na/ de dang nye ba na chu klung nai rañja na chu bsil la 'bab btegs bde ba shing gel pa mdzes pa dag gis brgyan pa'i sa phyogs lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ rtswa sngon po rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bus kun tu khyab pa zhig gzigs nas/ e ma ho 'di ni spong pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyi gnas su rung gi bdag gis sa 'di'i phyogs 'dir dka' thub kyi mthu bstan pas dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyi dka' thub kyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal gzhom par bya'o snyam nas shing rlon pa dang skam po'i bsrub shing srub brtan gyi dpe mngon du mdzad de/ byang chub sems dpas byi dor ma byas pa'i sa la skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug nas bsam gtan mkha' khyab la snyoms par 'jug par mdzad de/ rim gyis 'bras dang til dang mon sran dre'u gcig tsam nas zas gcad de// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag par gyur to// e ma ho mnyam med de ltar bka' ba spyod mdzad pa/ de tshe grong gi byis pa ba glang rdzis// sa yis bskus shing mi gtsang 'thor byed kyang*// g.yo med brtse bas bsam gtan mkha' khyab mdzad// sa steng cig yang ma gting par// skyil mo krung bcas g.yo ba med// til 'bru tsam zhig gsol mdzad de/ dbugs dbyung rngubs pa rnam par spangs// de ni nyi ma grib ma dang*// char rlung sha sbrang sdig sbrul gyis// gnod pas g.yo ba med par yang*/ de ni lo drug gnas par gyur// rdo rje'i lcags kyang nyi rlung rkyen gyis rnam par 'jigs par 'gyur// sa chen 'di yang dus tshigs rkyen gyis rab tu 'gyur zhing 'jigs// rdo rje'i lhun po nyi zlar bcas pa'ang dus mthar 'jigs par 'gyur// rgyal ba'i bsam gtan rkyen gyis g.yo zhing bskyod par gyur pa med/

de bas mthu chen khyad par rmad byung ba// de'i bsam gtan stobs la gzhan dag dga'// bdud kyi stobs kyang zil gyis rab mnan nas// lha rnams snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog par byed// de bas khyod kyi spyod pa rmad byung ba// 'jig rten lam las bzlog par gyur pa snyam/ de ltar byang chub sems dpas 'dod pa'i yon tan dang ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' gnyis kas bla na med pa'i byang chub mi thob par bstan cing*/ phyi ma'i skye bo rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir kha zas rags pa gsol bar mdzad pas na lnga sde 'di snyam du bsam ste/ ji ltar dka' ba spyad pa 'dis byang chub thob par mi nus na da ni thob par mi nus so snyam nas drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su song ngo*// byang chub sems dpa' la stobs ldan ma la sogs pa bcus bsnyen bkur zhing de dag tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir gsol bar mdzad de/ sku snga ma bzhin du gyur par bstan nas phyag dar khrod kyi ras blangs te/ chos gos kyi bya ba mdzad do// de'i tshe brgya byin gyis bskul bas grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas ba stong gi 'o ma lan bdun du nying khur byas pa bzang po sbrang rtsi ltar mngar bas gser gyi snod chen po bkang te byang chub sems dpa' la phul lo// byang chub sems dpas de bzhes shing gsol ma thag tu sku gser gtso ma sbyangs pa bzhin du gyur to// sngon gyi smon lam stobs kyis rab bskul ba// de gsol nas ni gnod de chu klung dor// klu dbang rgya mtshos blangs te brgya byin la// byin nas deng sang du yang mchod ces grags// dpal ldan de tshe bsod snyoms de gsol nas// a shwat+tha drung gshegs pa nyer dgongs tshe// dpag tshad brgyad cu'i khor ra khor yug tu// lha rnams kun gyis legs par brgyan par byas// seng ge'i stobs kyis byang chub snying po ru// mngon par gshegs pas sa rnams dal bus g.yos/

'od zer dra bas ngan song sdug bsngal bsal// 'di yi bkod pa'i khyad par mthu che dag /tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang gis dper byar min// de ltar byang chub shing drung byon par gyur// de tsha'i 'od zer gyi dra bas phog cing klu dung can zhes bya ba dmus long cig yod pa yang mig rnyed par gyur nas mchod pa du ma byed cing smras pa/ e ma bdag gi gnas 'dir las kyi nyi zla nor bu'i 'od kyang snang min la// 'dren pa 'jig rten dam pa dgun zla nya ba'i zhal 'dra mthong par gyur pa legs// bdag gis sngon ni drang srong rnams kyi mtshan ma mthong ba khyod kyang de 'dra te// de ring khyed kyis bdud kyi dpung rnams bcom te bzhed pa'i go 'phangs brnyed par 'gyur/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas bstod nas/ de nas byang chub kyi snying por byon zhing bzhugs pa na gdul bya'i dbang gis 'di ltar snang bar gyur te/ zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i phal pa rnams kyi snang ba la rtswa tshong bkra shis kyi rtswa sngon po rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bu 'jam zhing 'bol ba phul te byang chub kyi shing drung du rtswa'i gding ba la bzhugs te gsungs pa/ stan 'dir bdag gi lus 'di skams kyang rung*// lpags pa rus pa sha rnams zhig kyang rung*// bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub ma thob par// stan 'di la ni lus bskyod mi bya'o// zhes dam bcas nas bzhugs par snang ngo*// lha rnams kyi snang ba la ni shing yongs 'du bas kyang khyad par du 'phags pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung na lha'i 'byor pas zil gyis gnon pa'i bkod pa'i khyad par gyis bzhugs par snang ngo*// phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus grub pa'i gzhal med khang dang byang chub kyi shing gyi yon tan gyi bkod pa tshad med pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa rnam par 'gengs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing bkod pa mtha' yas pa nyid du snang te/

de'i rnam grangs bskal pa grangs med par brjod kyang mthas gtugs par ma mthong ngo*// de tshe rgyal ba'i sras po rnams// thub dbang rgyal la mchod don du// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i smon lam dang*/ mthun par rgyal la mchod par gyur// tshangs dang dbang po 'og min bdag po 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal bsod nams mthu yi dpal 'byor kyang*// bde ba'i rgyur gyur mthu chen ldan ces bsod nams chu gter rba rlabs mthu yis bskyod pa bzhin// de 'dir me khyer skar ma'i tshogs dang pad mo gnyen mchog stong phrag 'dus pa'i khyad par bzhin// dpag yas rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis kyang dpag par mi nus mthu'i khyad par gsal ba snyam/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams mchod par byed pa yang*// dpag med chus gter skra'i rtse mos min// nam mkha'i mtha' bzhin ngag gi lam 'das phyir// de bas 'dir ni dpag tu med pa yin/// /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por bzhugs nas 'di snyam du dgongs te/ 'di ltar 'jig rten khams kyi log par lta ba 'di dag gi gtso bo 'dod pa'i khams kyang dbang phyug la dbang bsgyur ba'i bdud sdig can 'di ma btul na mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams tshar gcad par mi 'gyur zhing gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par bstan par mi 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs nas/ bdud btul bar bya ba'i phyir/ mdzod spu las bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer phyung ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bdud kyi gnas thams cad rab tu g.yos shing mog mog por byas te// sgra 'di yang grags so// sems can shin tu dag pa bskal mang spyod spyad pa// zas gtsang sras pos rgyal srid dag ni rab spangs te// phan byed de ni bdud rtsi 'dod pas mngon par byung*// byang chub shing drung 'ongs kyis de ring bsgrims par bgyis// bdud sdig can gyis de lta bu'i sgra thos shing bdud kyi sde rnams kha sbub du 'gyel ba la sogs pa'i rmi lam sum cu so gnyis kyang rmis te/

'jigs skrag bsngangs shing brtags na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu yin par shes shing*/ bdag nyid 'dod pa'i dbang phyug las nyams pa dang*/ bdud kyi gnas thams cad stongs par gyur du dogs pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa'i dug gis snying la khyab par rod rod por gyur to// rang gi 'khor rnams la smras pa/ shākya'i nang du skyes gyur pa// dge slong g.yo can cig byung ste// des ni nga gnas stong par byed/ dpung chen rnams dang lhan cig tu// mthu rtsal chen pos der 'dong la// dge sbyong cig de gzhom par bya/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa smras nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dpung chen po nas mnar med pa yan chad kyi bdud kyi dmag chen po dpung che zhing stobs che ba 'jigs su rung ba spu zing zhes byed nus pa lha dang mi rnams kyis sngon ma thos ma mthong ba bzhin bsgyur ba rnam pa mang po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma bsgyur ba'i rnam pa dang ldan pa/ dbang po'i sgo nas sbrul gdug pa dang lcags kyi ser ba 'bebs pa/ me dang dug gis rlangs 'thul zhing 'bar ba dang klog 'byin pa/ 'ga' zhig ni rkang lag dang mig log par 'dug pa/ rkang lag sbrul brgya stong gis dkris pa/ ral gri dang*/ mda' gzhu dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ mtshon rtse cig pa dang*/ shag ti dang*/ mdung dang*/ chu gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha brgyad stong thogs pa/ gdong du ma can/ me'i dra ba dang*/ ri'i 'phreng ba dang*/ rlung dang*/ rdo dang*/ gnam lcags kyi char 'bebs pa la sogs pa/ gcan gzan gyi tshogs du ma la bzhon pa/ yid du mi 'ong pa'i sgra sna tshogs 'jigs 'jigs ltar sgrogs pa/ nam mkha' dang sa gzhi thams cad bar mtshams med par bkang te/ drag po'i rlung gis bskyod pa'i rlung nag po bzhin du byang chub kyi shing drung ga la ba der 'ongs so// de tshe bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams/ sdig can gyis ni rab bskul bas// sems kyang rod rod por gyur te// mtshon cha'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa dang*// rang gi rdzu 'phrul stobs 'khrugs pas// sna tshogs nga ro sgrogs byed can// thog gi tshub mas kun tu 'gengs/

ri dang me lce'i 'phreng ba dag /'ur 'ur long long kun tu 'bebs// rlung dang rdo dang gnam lcags char// rab tu 'bebs pas ri bo dang*// sa chen kun tu g.yo byed cing*// sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i gzugs brnyan rnams// mtshan mo de la nye bar lhags/ de ltar bdud kyi dmag chen pos mthong ba tsam gyis byis pa'i skye bo rnams snying 'gas par byed pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang drag shul gyi mthus ri rab kyang thal bar byed par nus pa'i bdud kyi dmag chen po byang chub kyi shing drung du lhags pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' de lta bu'i gzugs dang sgra byis pa'i skye bo rnams kyis mi mthong zhing ma thos par byin gyis rlabs so// de nas bdud kyi dmag gi tshogs de rnams thams cad kyis 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra bsgrags shing mtshon cha'i char phab pa las/ de dag thams cad ni me tog dang spos dang*/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin du gyur to// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'ga' zhig gi snang ba la ni khro bo'i rgyal po chen po rnams kyis bdud kyi 'khor thams cad rab tu bcom par byas pa mthong ngo*// de nas bdud sdig can gyi dpung dmag gis tshogs thams cad 'thor zhing rab tu 'thor/ bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa dang bkod pa tshad med par gyur pa de yang mthong nas/ nyams chung zhing yid mi bde bar gyur bzhin du smras pa/ kye rgyal bu gzhon nu bzhengs bzhengs rgyal srid la spyod cig /khyod kyi bsod nams de tsam gyis thar pa ga la thob/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' brtan la zab cing rgya che ba 'jam zhing snyan pa'i tshig gis smras pa/ sdig can khyod kyis ni brtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin cig gis 'dod pa'i dbang phyug thob par zad kyis/ ngas ni mchod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma brtan la med pa byas so// de'i tshe bdud kyis smras pa/

kho bos sngon chad mchod sbyin kha na ma tho med// brtan pa med par byas pa khyod 'dir dbang du yod// khyod la 'di na dbang po 'gag yang yong min la// smras kyang phan pa ci yod/ khyod ni pham par 'gyur// de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog lta bus sa la reg te smras pa/ sa 'di 'gro ba kun gyi spang yin te// rgyu dang mi rgyu snyoms shing nye 'khon med// 'di ni bdag gi spang te bdag brdzun min/ 'di la khyod ni bdag gi spang byos shig /de'i tshe sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug du g.yos shing sa'i lha mo bstan ma 'khor bye ba phrag brgya dang bcas pa sa la brdol te byung nas/ byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der logs su btud nas skyes bu chen po de de bzhin no// ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du 'di ni bdag la mngon sum mo// zhes smras nas rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa de nyid du mi gnang bar gyur to// g.yon can dpung bcas sgra de thos gyur nas// nags su seng ge sgra bsgrags bas thos dang*// bya rog rdo 'phangs mod la byer ba bzhin// skrag dngangs snying gas mod la rab tu byer/ de'i tshe gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu dag gis kyang spyo ba bcu drug gis bdud nyams smad par mdzad de sdug bsngal zhing rang gi gnas su song nas mya ngan gyi khang par zhugs te 'dug go /de nas bdud kyi bu mo sred ma dang*/ dga' byed ma dang*/ dga' spyod ma zhes bya ba bdud sdig can ga la ba der song te smras pa/ yab khyod ci phyir thugs mi bde/ ci phyir 'di na 'di ltar bzhugs// gang gis khyed la gnod pa yis/ skyes bu gang la rjes su sems// gsungs shig de ni 'dod chags kyi// zhags pas nags nas glang po bzhin// bcings nas bdag cag 'tshal te mchi// de ni khyod kyi dbang du gyur// bdud kyis smras pa/ skyes bu 'dod chags dang bral te// chags pas legs par dgug mi nus// bdud kyi yul 'das de'i phyir// nga ni shin tu mya ngan byed// de nas bdud kyi bu mo gsum lus kyi lang tsho yis dregs shing sprin las byung ba'i glog bzhin gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing rang gi gnas nas// bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der logs su phyin pa dang*/

bud med kyi sgyu rtsal sum cu so gnyis ston par byed de/ lus dang ngag gis slu bar byed pa'i rnam pa bstan te/ slar de dag gi rgyags pa gzhig par bya ba'i phyir bdud kyi bu mo de dag rgad shing 'khogs la mi sdug pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs so// de nas bdud kyi bu mo de dag zhum zhing ngo tsha bas bdud sdig can gyi drung du song te smras pa/ skyes bu chags rab bral de la// bdag cag gis ni ma byas pa// rnam par gang yang yod min na/ tha mar gzugs ni 'di 'dra ba// de'i mthu yis snang bar byas// 'di la yab kyis bskyab par mdzod// bdud kyis smras pa/ 'di ni bdag la dbang med kyis// ji srid thub pa de nyid la// skyabs su 'gro bar gyis shig dang*// khyod kyi gzugs 'di gzhan du 'gyur// zhes rjes su bstan pa thos nas bcom ldan 'das la bzod par gsol te mchod pas lus sngar bzhin du legs par gyur to// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bdud bye ba sum cu rtsa drug dang*// khrag khrig nyi shu rtsa bzhi byang chub du smin par mdzad do// gang gi 'dod pa'i dbang phyug bdud kyi mthu// ting 'dzin mthu yis legs par bcom 'gyur nas// 'jig rten chos kyi rgyal srid legs 'dzugs pa// rgyal ba rnams kyi thabs 'di dpag tu med// de nas bdud dang phyir rgol ba rnams rab tu bcom pa'i rjes de nyid la byang chub kyi shing drung du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis spyod yul du gyur pa'i bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug pa mdzad cing skya rengs shar ba'i dus kyi tshe 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis shes par bya ba dang thob pa dang*/ lta ba dang khong du chud pa mngon du bya ba gang ci yang rung ba thams cad sems kyi skad cig cig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis spang par bya ba rnams ni spangs/ thob par bya ba ni mngon du mdzad de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so// skad cig de nyid la ta la bdun srid du/

'phags te lam gyi rgyun ni chad do// sdug bsngal nye bar zhi'o// zag pa ni skams te mi zag go /lam ni chad de yang mi 'jug go /zhes ched du brjod pas ched du brjod do// skyes bu khyu mchog 'dren pa byang chub sangs rgyas nas// khrag khrig zhing rnams spyod cing bdud kyang pham par mdzad// tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ka la ping ka'i sgra skad kyis// 'dren pas thog mar tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so// bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel// bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yis bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub// bdud bcom nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur// mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po 'thob// de bas bsod nams byas pas chog par su zhig 'dzin// bdud rtsi chos nyan pas kyang chog par su zhig 'dzin// skye bo med pa'i nags gnas chog par su zhig 'dzin// sems can don bya bas kyang chog par su zhig 'dzin// zhes gsungs shing*/ skad cig de la sangs rgyas kyi rol ba dpag tu med pa mdzad de/ de dag ni bskal par yang brjod par mi lang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' yas mu med gyur pa rnams// zhing gi yon tan rgya mtsho'i bkod pa rmad byung ba// rgyal sras rgya mtshos kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rnams// kun tu mchod cing chos tshul rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa/ zhing rnams kun tu gsal bar gyur pa brjod mi nus// 'jig rten sgron ma mtshungs pa med 'di dus 'dir byung*/// /de ltar bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'jig rten du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bzhed de/ 'di ltar bsdus pa'i tshul gyis smras pa/ rnam 'dren da ltar sangs rgyas nas// shing dbang drung du bdun phrag bzhugs// stong gsum kun tu 'chag pa dang*// shing la gzigs shing bzhad par mdzad/ rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs zhabs kyis bcags// gtang bzungs gnas na bzhugs pa dang*// n+ya gro ta'i shing drung bzhugs// shing rgyal sgrol rgyu'i drung 'dug pa// de ltar bdun phrag bdun gyi bar// 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir tshul 'di snang*// mthu chen rmad byung byang chub spyod mchog rab bstan pa// bdun phrag dang po shing dbang drung du rgyal ba'i sras// kun tu bzang pos zhing mchog rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bstan// rgyal chen rigs bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum mtshe ma dang*/

dga' ldan 'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang byed gnas rnams su// bdun phrag bdun du rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab snang te// phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rgyal sras rgya mtsho legs 'dus pas// rnam thar chos tshul rgya mtsho'i bkod pa bstan mdzad ces// tshul 'dir rgyal bas bstan par gyur ces mdo las grags// de tshe ga gon bzang pos kyang*// thog mar rgyal ba mchod ces grags// de tshe rgyal po bzhi po yis// dad pas rgyal la lhung zed phul// tshong pa rnams la shis brjod cing*// rgyal ba'i dbang por lung yang bstan// de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ kye ma ngas thob pa'i chos 'di ni zab pa rtog ge'i spyod yul las 'das pa yin na// 'di ltar 'jig rten pa dag gis rtogs par dka' zhing*/ tshangs pa la mchog tu 'dzin na des mngon par ma bskul gyi bar du bstan par mi bya'o// snyam du dgongs nas gsungs pa/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi'i chos ni bdag gis thob par gyur/ bdag gis bstan kyang gzhan gyis mi shes te// mi smra nags 'dab gnas par bya'o snyam/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs nas 'od chen pos kyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bar mdzad do// de'i tshe tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thugs las chung ngur bzhugs pa shes te/ skad cig de la tshangs pa 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba btab pa// ma ga da 'dir sngon chad chos byung ba// dag pa ma lags dri mar bcas par rtogs// bdud rtsi chos kyi sgo ni phye mdzod la// dri ma med pa rtogs pa bshad par mdzod// zhes pa la sogs pas bskul ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes kyis spyan gyis gzigs nas/ kha cig ni log pa nyid du gzigs/ kha cig ni yang dag pa nyid du nges/ kha cig ni ma nges par gzigs nas/

ma nges pa rnams la brtse ba bskyed de/ bka' bstsal pa/ tshangs pa 'jig rten yul gyi sems can gang*// rna ba ldan zhing dad dang ldan gyur la// mi tshe 'du shes rtag tu chos nyan pas/ de dag la ni bdud rtsi'i sgo dbye'o// zhes gsungs te/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa rnams dga' zhing mgu nas mchod cing bstod de/ rang gi gnas su song ngo/// /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thog mar drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi gnas su byon te/ lnga sde bzang po yongs su smin par mdzad de// tshur shog gi bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad de/ chos ston par bzhed pa na/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sa phyogs der rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i khri stong byung bar gyur te/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la gus pa mdzad pa'i phyir khri gsum la ni bskor ba mdzad nas seng ge ltar bag tsha ba mi mnga' bar khri bzhi pa la skyil mo krung bcas nas 'dug go /de'i tshe 'od zer gyis stong gsum gyis stong chen po'i khams thams cad snang bar mdzad nas/ phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ lha tshad med pa rnams skul zhing 'dus par gyur te/ de thams cad la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la brtsams nas lan gsum du rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro// mi mchog seng ges seng ge'i sgra sgrags pas// de tshe sa 'di 'di ltar rnam drug g.yos// bye ba drug phrag drug cu'i 'od zer 'gyed// ngan 'gro'i 'gro rnams kun tu bsil bar mdzad// rgyal sras mthu chen du ma mngon par lhags// rgyal ba gang tshe 'khor lo bskor gyur pa// rgyal ba'i sras rnams de tshe mig rnyed cing*// rgyal sras lnga ste de tshe dgra bcom gyur// de tshe lnga sde mig rnyed cing*// zag pa zad par gyur ces grags/ grags pa gang po ba glang bdag /grong khyer khye'u lnga cu dang*// thog mar dgra bcom drug cu byung*// de nas steng rgyas grong khyer du/

drug cu sde yi tshogs btul zhing*// legs skyes ma sogs gdams pa mdzad// de nas steng rgyas 'od srungs la sogs pa// brgya phrag bcu rnams rab tu phyung bar gyur// de dag don du rgyal bas snang mdzad pa// cho 'phrul gsum gyis 'phags pa'i lam la bkod// ga ya go na rgyal po'i khab tu byon// gzugs can snying po la sogs skye bo'i tshogs// rab rib gsal nas chos kyi mig bstan mdzad// nye rgyal dang ni spang nas skyes// 'khor dang bcas pa rab byung zhing*// mo'u 'gal bu dang sha ri'i bu// rdzu 'phrul shes rab ldan mchog tu// de'i tshe na grags par gyur// de nas ser skya'i grong khyer du/ rdzu 'phrul chen pos nyer byon nas// shākya'i tshogs rnams 'dul bar mdzad// shākya'i bzang ldan nam gru dang*// ma 'gags pa dang lha byin sogs// shākya'i tshogs rnams rab tu phyung*// de tshe gsol bzhi'i las mdzad gyur// gzhan yang nye bar 'khor sogs pa// grong khyer bye bas brgyan pa'i yul// kun tu tshangs spyod rgya chen grags// de tshe bslab tshig rab bcas shing*// zhing dang dul dang sdom pa'i don// 'dod pa'i gnyen por rab gyur pa// stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi tshangs pa'i 'khor lo bskor zhes grags// rgyal po'i khab kyi ri bo nyams dga' bar// sna tshogs ljon pa'i tshogs kyis rab gang zhing*// bya rnams du ma sgra 'byin nags tshal ldan// sna tshogs ri dwags 'khrugs pa'i sa phyogs su// lha dbang mi dbang gtsug gis legs mchod cing*/ rgyal sras mthu chen ldan pa'i tshogs rnams la// chos rnams thams cad ngo bo nyid med par// ston mdzad rmad byung bla na med pa'i gsung*// ngag tshig dri med mdo sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs// sdug bsngal bsgral phyir 'gro la snying brtse'i phyir// stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig rnam grangs kyis// zab cing zhi bar ston byed 'khor lo bskor/ 'di dag seng ge'i stong nyid sgra dag gis/

bdag lta'i ri dwags tshogs rnams bcom zhes grags// de tshe gnyan yod sa phyogs su// mu stegs tshogs rnams gdul bya'i phyir// sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul lam dag gis// cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa mdzad// yul ni me dag ces bya bar// lha las babs pa bzang po mdzad// sum cu rtsa gsum dag du'ang*// chos nyid la ni brgya byin sbyar// sna tshogs lha dang mi rnams kyis// phan bde'i 'bras bu bstsol bar mdzad// de nas gnas gtsang 'og min du// theg pa gsum la rjes 'jug pa'i// dam chos sngags kyi 'khor lo ni// rnal 'byor tshul la brten pa bskor// mi zad gdug pa gcod pa'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ rtsod ldan mi rnams rdo rje'i theg la 'jug 'gyur zhes// de nas rgyal sras gsang ba'i mnga' bdag mchog rnams dang*// lha dang mi la bla na med pa'i theg pa mchog /dpal ldan rgyu skar dam pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor du bla na med pa'i lam mchog dpal dang ldan pa bstan// rtsa can yul du brgyad kyi tshogs rnams nyer brtul nas// tha ma'i chos rnams sa la zung gis gnas su bstan// de bzhin lha dbang klu dbang dri za mi'am ci// mkha' lding lha min gdul bya sna tshogs rab 'dul ba// mdzad pa'i chos tshul dpag med rnam thar rgya mtsho ni/ don dam rnam nges chos sgo stong phrag nyi shu gcig /rdo rje'i sngags tshul chos sgo nyi khri chig stong dang*// brgyad khri bzhi stong dam chos 'khor lo bskor gyur pas// dpag med mkha' mnyam sems can grangs rnams de snyed pa// 'dul ba'i 'phrin las gdul bya 'dul byed 'dres pa bzhin/ pad ma'i tshal la nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin du 'jug /de bas 'dir ni bskal mang spyod pa rab spyad pa'i// don de gsal bar yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa snyam// de ltar na bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phrin las dang*/ dam pa'i chos bsam gyi mi khyab cing*/ sems can kyang mtha' yas pa'i phyir/

dam pa'i chos kyi sgo dang mdzad pa dang*/ 'phrin las bstan pa 'ang bsam gyis mi khyab bo// de nas bcom ldan 'das snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams la 'dul bar byed pa'i sgo gzigs shing*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku mngon du snang bar mi nus pa'i gdul bya rnams phal che bar gyur pa'i dbang gi yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ston par mdzad de/ dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes bcwo lnga'i nyin bar yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba na/ gsung chen po'i srid pa'i rtse mo man chad khyab par/ deng de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye bo rnams la thugs brtse ba can sems can gyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa de yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o// gang the tshom dang som nyis su gyur pa dag zhu zhing gsol ba'i dus la bab po zhes pa yongs su grags par gyur to// de tshe 'od zer bye ba phrag drug cu// bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od zer byed pa rnams/ zil gyis mnan cing 'og min mthas gtugs par/ gsal byas 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams thams cad kun// mya ngan rlung gis bskyod par gyur pa las// rgya mtsho'i gru chen bzhin du lus g.yos shing*// mya ngan rlabs kyi sgra grags chil chil gyis// dus gcig cho nges ngu zhing 'di skad smras// kye ma'o shin tu byams pa'i pha ma 'dra// kyi hud kyi hud mya ngan 'da' ces grags// slan chad rgyal ba mchog de mthong mi 'gyur// de bas myur du deng 'dir rings par 'dong*/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa smras nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sems pa'i yid kyis rings pa rings par rtsa mchog gi grong khyer ga la ba der song te/ de'i tshe dge slong gi dge 'dun brgya stong phrag du ma dang*/ dge slong ma'i khri phrag drug cu rnyed dang*/ klu 'bum phrag ji rnyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dge bsnyen dang*/ dge bsnyen ma tshad med pa rnams dang*/

skye bo tshogs tshad med pa rnams dang*/ 'og min gyi lha'i mthas gtugs pa'i mi dang*/ mi ma yin pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba shes nas ci ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa'i khyad par dpag tu med pa dang bcas pas sā la zung gnyis gnas ste nyid du lhags so// de'i tshe thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi sgo tshad med pa bstan cing byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'dus pa dpag tu med pa la sogs pa 'khor 'dus pa thams cad la yongs su smin pa'i bya ba mdzad cing*/ tsun das sbyar ba'i zhal zas kyi mtha' ma la gsol bar mdzad nas/ dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' dang*/ kun tu rgyu rab bzang la sogs pa'i gdul bya'i tha ma rnams brtul ba brtan nas/ kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ shing sā la zung gi bar du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzims khri shoms shig /de nas de'i tshe kun dga' bos mya ngan byed la smre sngags 'don zhing mchi mas snang la ngu zhing gdong la mchi ma 'dzag bzhin du ngu zhing*/ sā la zung gyi bar du bcom ldan 'das kyi seng ge'i khri bshams so// de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa'i 'di dag smras so// thub chen seng ge'i gzims khri ni// bshams pa'i tha ma deng lags te// mi mchog seng ge'i gzims khri ni// slan chad bsham du ma mchis so// mi mchog mya ngan 'das gyur cing*// 'jig rten mgon po 'das pa na// sa la mdzes tshal stong pa yi// khro 'dir bdag gi ji ltar lta// gang zhing sā la'i ljon tshal na// yun ring gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha// der ni rnam 'dren ma mthong na// slan chad ci ltar gnas par 'gyur// kye ma'o 'du byed mi rtag ste// sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu lags// 'di 'dra'i ston pa dpa' bo yang*/ 'di nyid du ni 'da' bar 'gyur/ de nas bcom ldan 'das khri de nyid la seng ge'i stabs kyis gzims ma thag tu/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu g.yos shing*/

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i bsam gtan gyi rnam par thar pa bstan nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba chen pos yongs su mya ngan las 'das so// de tshe 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams kun// 'jig rten nyi ma nub bo zhes// kun tu smre sngags 'don pa'i sgra// rgya mtsho ca co 'byin pa bzhin// sgra chen mngon par grags par gyur// sna tshogs mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// sprin gyis sa steng khyab par byas// de tshe dad pa'i sems kyis ni// mchi ma'i thigs pa char bzhin bab// kha cig lcugs phran gcad pa bzhin// sa steng mngon par dgyel bar gyur// lha dang mi rnams so so nas// nyams thag nga ro'i sgra 'byin cing*// mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa dang*// bdag med don la lta bar gyur// de ltar 'jig rten khyab par snang*// de tshe stong gsum ri dang sa chen rnams// ma bzod bzhin du g.yos pa gyur pa 'dra// ljon shing nags tshal me tog rgyas pa rnams// dga' ba bzhin du g.yo zhing brgyal ba bzhin// lo ma me tog rab gsal 'bras bu'i tshogs// sprin phung rlung gis bskyod par gyur pa bzhin// nam mkha'i ngos kun khyab par dus gcig byung*// rgyal ba'i chos tshul zab mo ston pa yi/ tshul rnams mngon sum gsol bar byas pa 'dra// sna tshogs lha dang mi yi rol mo rnams// skye bo'i ngag dang lhan cig 'brel pa bzhin// sa steng de tshe ca co 'byin par gyur// bcom ldan 'das ni sngon gyi smon lam gyis// bdag cag phyi ru mi mjed 'jig rten gshegs// tshad med dbang du gyur pa'i gnas bcas nas// 'phong pa chos 'dod 'gro ba rnams kyang brtul/ bcom ldan sems can rnams la byams pa'i yum// lha ri 'phongs pa'i mgon ma mchis par gyur// kyi hud 'gro ba'i dge ba'i myu gu yang*// skye ba'i char ni 'bab pa'i dus ma mchis// 'jig rten stongs so da ni ji ltar bgyid// sems can yang dag ye shes mig mdongs so// kyi hud ci phyir 'jig rten ngan pa 'dir// bcom ldan bdag cag spangs nas mya ngan 'da'/

zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i smre sngags du ma smra zhing*/ thams cad kyi rim gro bskyed de mchod pa'i khyad par grangs med pa dag gis mchod nas/ 'od srungs chen po la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang nye bar song nas mchod pa chen po byas te/ de tshe dpag med thugs rje yi// stobs las byung ba'i me 'od kyis/ phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor gsal mdzad de// thugs rje'i stobs kyis sku gdung rnams// yungs 'bru tsam du snang bar gyur// de nas dge slong ma 'gags pas// sku gdung thal bar bcas pas rnams// so sor byin te mchod par gyur// skyes bu mchog de'i mche ba bzhi// brgya byin dang ni sgra sgrogs klu// tshig 'dzin ka ling rgyal po yi// nye bar mchod pa'i 'os su gyur// ser skya'i rgyal po shāka rigs dang*// ma skyes dgra dang yangs pa can// byi nu tha dang cha la ka// ka shi ka'i rgyal po rnams// khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze sogs/ rgyal ba'i ring srel rtsod par gyur// de tshe bram ze bre bo yis /mnyam par bsgos te mchod pa byas// spyan ldan sku gdung mchod rten brgyad dag la/ bdun ni 'dzam bu gling pas mchod pa thob// skyes bu mchog de bre bo gang zhig ni// grong khyer sgra sgrogs klu'i rgyal pos mchod// mya ngan med rgyal skya nar bu yis ni// mchod rten bdun po rgya chen spel bar byas// de'i mthu yis sa rnams thams cad du// rgyal ba'i mchod rten kun gyis brgyan par gyur// gsung rabs dri med 'gro la phan byed rnams// rgyal sras rnams kyis 'du' bar mdzad ces grags// rab mkhyen thugs rjer ldan pa stobs bcu'i shugs mnga' ba// shākya'i rigs 'khrungs ma ga dhar ni byang chub pa// ka shi kar ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur nas// grong khyer rtswa can brten nas yongs su mya ngan 'das/ rtsod pa'i dus na brtsad par bya ba rnams spangs shing*// dpag med yon tan dpag pa'i gnas las 'das gyur kyang*// gdul bya'i blo ltar 'dul byed mdzad pa bstan pa 'di/

dpa' bo dpal ldan khyod kyis sgyu ma bstan pa snyam// de bas bdag gis snyan ngag mchod pas legs mchod cing*// brtan pa'i sems kyis rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa'i skyes pa'i rabs te brgya dang gcig pa'o/// /sdom la/ 'pho dang lhums su zhugs pa bltams pa dang*// bzo dang rol rtsed nges 'byung dang*// dka' spyad drung gshegs bdud sde 'joms// byang chub chos 'khor mya ngan 'das// dpal ldan thub pa'i mdzad pa mkha' ltar rgya che la// phyogs phyogs bsam pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur snang*// de ni tha dad 'phrin las rkyen gyis so sor shar// lam mchog dpal ldan brtan cing sems can don gyur pa// rmad byung mtha' yas yon tan mthu mnga' gcig pu yi// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa brtan pa dag /dpa' bo zhes byas snyan ngag me tog phreng mdzes pas// rgyan par byas zhes phyogs phyogs kun tu gsal bar grags/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus don ldan pa// bcu phrag gsum dang bzhir ni gnas khang der bzhag pa// rgya gar yul du lnga rigs blo ldan du mas kyang*/ snyan ngag rgya mtsho so so'i blo gros rgya mtsho chu klung gis// 'gran par ma nus zhum zhing dor ba bzhin du gyur// gangs can khrod 'dir mkhas par rlom rnams smos ci dgos// de ltar dpag dka' rgyal ba'i lung bstan snyan ngag mkhan// mtshungs med dpa' bo yang 'dir byung ba ma yin kyang*// dus mthar rgyal dang de sras spyod la dad byed pa// rang byung rgyal ba mchog la rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i// mi phyed dad ldan bdag gi snyan ngag blo gros ni// thugs rje ldan dang 'jam dbyangs rgyal sras ma pham pas// nye bar bsgyubs pas bcu phrag drug dang bdun lhag pa'i// rmad byung mdzad pa gsal bar byas pa 'di yis ni// lam yangs dri med byang chub spyod tshul gsal byed cing*// bstan bcos don kyi lus kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur// de bas 'dir ni bdag gis 'bad pa don yod bar// 'gyur bar mkhas mchog rnams kyis brten par bya bar rigs// 'ga' zhig 'jig rten don ldan min yang ngag tshig bsdebs sbyor lhur len pa// gzhan dag rmad byung don gyi rjes 'jug 'di yang blo gros ldan la yod// gnyis ka'i tshul la rnam par rmongs gyur rnam spyod mi ldan 'jig rten dag

/'jig rten snang byed 'od zer gyis ni reg par mi nus stobs chung ba// rang gi lta ngan lhur len byed pas gzhung 'di smad par nus ma yin// lung dang rigs pa'i gtsug lag lam la 'gal bar gyur gang smad pa'i rigs// 'di ltar rmad byung mdzad pa gsal byed pa'i// skyes rabs 'di byas nga rgyal mthu yis min// khe dang grags pa longs spyod 'dod phyir min// snyigs dus rgya cher 'gyur snyam 'di ma byas// rgyal ba'i spyod 'di 'jig rten rmad byung la// tshul 'dis nam zhig 'gro phan byed 'gyur bar// bdag kyang 'gyur zhes smon pa'i mthu yis ni// byang chub spyod mchog rab tu gsal bar bstan// de las byung ba'i dge ba dri ma med pa des// mtha' yas 'gro rnams byang chub spyod la rab 'jug cing*// ngag tshig gzugs dang yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs thob nas// the tshom gcod byed rgyal ba'i dbang por 'gyur bar shog /de ltar skyes pa'i rabs kyi rgyud/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i sum cu so bzhi pa las/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang*/ sa bcu mthar phyin pa'i sar sbyor ba'i don du phyi ma drug cu rtsa bdun pa/ mdo du ma las byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa/ zab mo'i mdo sde rnams la chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa/ rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba yongs su rdzogs so// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog// /na mo rad ṇa tra ya yā/ tad+ya thā/ ā+oṃ yā+e dha rmā he du pra bha lba/ he dun te sh+ṇa ta tha ga to/ h+ya bha dad tā+e/ sh+ṇa tsa yo ṇi ro ḍā// e baṃ bā ti// ma hā shra ma ṇe ye swahā// ā+oṃ sa rba byid swāhā// he he ཿho ho ho ཿhu hu hu ཿha ha haḥ/// /
